paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation” presents the proportional breakdown of data sources used in the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets, showing six slices in total. The categories and approximate percentages are ENTITYQUEST in blue at 26.0%, HOTPOTQA in red at 24.2%, TRIVIAQA in orange at 22.7%, POPQA in yellow at 21.6%, WEBQUESTIO in teal at 3.6%, and TREC in green at 1.9%. Each slice is annotated with an external label and percentage connected by leader lines (rather than a separate legend), and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the arrangement of segments does not appear strictly ordered by size.
